name: MRI Registration QC (FA maps)
summary: Checks the quality of a diffusion registration by comparing fractional anisotropy maps from a fixed and a registered moving tensor dataset with similarity metrics (NMI, NCC, MSE, SSIM) and QC figures.
description: Reorients both images to RAS+, averages 4-D images over time, resamples the moving image into the fixed grid if needed, then computes normalised mutual information, normalised cross-correlation, mean squared error and SSIM with a qualitative label (excellent/good/fair/poor). It writes metrics.json and per-view PNG figures (fixed, moving, checkerboard with edge overlay, absolute difference), plus AFNI edge-alignment montages when AFNI is available. Use it after a registration App to check alignment; it does not change the images. This variant reads the FA maps of two tensor datasets; with thr_mask it also computes overlap metrics on thresholded masks.

inputs.description: Registered (moving) tensor dataset; its FA map is compared with the fixed FA.
inputs.requirements: Should already be registered to the fixed data.

inputs.description: Reference (fixed) tensor dataset; its FA map is used.

outputs.description: QC figures (PNG) for axial, coronal and sagittal views and the similarity metrics.

parameters.description: A visualization that alternates patches of two images in a checkerboard pattern to highlight local alignment differences.

A threshold-based mask applied to both fixed and moving images to compute overlap metrics (e.g., Dice), where a single value (LOW) selects voxels with values > LOW, and two values (LOW,HIGH) select voxels with LOW < value < HIGH.
